purpose: Institute Employee Operational Access Rule: verify permitted outcome
preconditions: Actor, role context, file association, and lifecycle state meet rule conditions.
action_or_input: Exercise permitted case: Only Institute Employee users (Faculty/Staff operating under assigned roles) may perform operational file-processing actions in FTS.
expected_result: Allow operational processing only for authorized Institute Employees; System Admin remains strictly outside routine operational file processing.

purpose: Institute Employee Operational Access Rule: verify prohibited outcome
preconditions: Actor, role context, file association, and lifecycle state meet rule conditions.
action_or_input: Exercise prohibited case: Only Institute Employee users (Faculty/Staff operating under assigned roles) may perform operational file-processing actions in FTS.
expected_result: Allow operational processing only for authorized Institute Employees; System Admin remains strictly outside routine operational file processing.

purpose: Role Switching Preservation Rule: verify required outcome
preconditions: Actor, role context, file association, and lifecycle state meet rule conditions.
action_or_input: Exercise required case: Switching assigned role context shall not change existing file ownership or previously recorded audit history.
expected_result: Apply the selected role to authorization while preserving ownership and historical audit identity.

purpose: Persistent Composite File Rule: verify permitted outcome
preconditions: Actor, role context, file association, and lifecycle state meet rule conditions.
action_or_input: Exercise permitted case: An FTS file is a persistent composite object containing mandatory user comments at creation/movement stages and optional attachments; circulated contents and movement records are retained.
expected_result: Persist the file and accumulated contents after circulation; do not delete circulated contents through draft-discard behavior.

purpose: Persistent Composite File Rule: verify prohibited outcome
preconditions: Actor, role context, file association, and lifecycle state meet rule conditions.
action_or_input: Exercise prohibited case: An FTS file is a persistent composite object containing mandatory user comments at creation/movement stages and optional attachments; circulated contents and movement records are retained.
expected_result: Persist the file and accumulated contents after circulation; do not delete circulated contents through draft-discard behavior.

purpose: Initial Comment Requirement: verify permitted outcome
preconditions: Actor, role context, file association, and lifecycle state meet rule conditions.
action_or_input: Exercise permitted case: A new FTS file requires an initial mandatory user comment.
expected_result: Block acceptance of file creation until the initial comment is present.

purpose: Initial Comment Requirement: verify prohibited outcome
preconditions: Actor, role context, file association, and lifecycle state meet rule conditions.
action_or_input: Exercise prohibited case: A new FTS file requires an initial mandatory user comment.
expected_result: Block acceptance of file creation until the initial comment is present.

purpose: Draft Boundary Rule: verify permitted outcome
preconditions: Actor, role context, file association, and lifecycle state meet rule conditions.
action_or_input: Exercise permitted case: Draft save/edit/discard behavior is permitted only before submission/circulation; a circulated file is not deleted as a draft.
expected_result: Permit draft operations only in pre-circulation state and prevent draft deletion after circulation.

purpose: Draft Boundary Rule: verify prohibited outcome
preconditions: Actor, role context, file association, and lifecycle state meet rule conditions.
action_or_input: Exercise prohibited case: Draft save/edit/discard behavior is permitted only before submission/circulation; a circulated file is not deleted as a draft.
expected_result: Permit draft operations only in pre-circulation state and prevent draft deletion after circulation.

purpose: File-Movement Comment Requirement: verify permitted outcome
preconditions: Actor, role context, file association, and lifecycle state meet rule conditions.
action_or_input: Exercise permitted case: Every file-movement action requires a mandatory comment from the acting user.
expected_result: Block movement until the mandatory movement comment is supplied.

purpose: File-Movement Comment Requirement: verify prohibited outcome
preconditions: Actor, role context, file association, and lifecycle state meet rule conditions.
action_or_input: Exercise prohibited case: Every file-movement action requires a mandatory comment from the acting user.
expected_result: Block movement until the mandatory movement comment is supplied.

purpose: Receiver and Return Eligibility Rule: verify permitted outcome
preconditions: Actor, role context, file association, and lifecycle state meet rule conditions.
action_or_input: Exercise permitted case: A file may be sent to another Institute Employee regardless of the receiver’s role, and a received file may be returned to its sender where the current user is permitted to act.
expected_result: Accept only a valid Institute Employee recipient for send/forward; route return to the sender of the received movement, subject to authorization/file-state permissions.

purpose: Receiver and Return Eligibility Rule: verify prohibited outcome
preconditions: Actor, role context, file association, and lifecycle state meet rule conditions.
action_or_input: Exercise prohibited case: A file may be sent to another Institute Employee regardless of the receiver’s role, and a received file may be returned to its sender where the current user is permitted to act.
expected_result: Accept only a valid Institute Employee recipient for send/forward; route return to the sender of the received movement, subject to authorization/file-state permissions.

purpose: Chronological Movement Record Rule: verify required outcome
preconditions: Actor, role context, file association, and lifecycle state meet rule conditions.
action_or_input: Exercise required case: FTS shall record forwarding and return events chronologically with sender, receiver, timestamp, movement comment, and movement attachments where present.
expected_result: Append movement event and its details to chronological history; update holder/pending-recipient information consistently.

purpose: Associated File Access Rule: verify permitted outcome
preconditions: Actor, role context, file association, and lifecycle state meet rule conditions.
action_or_input: Exercise permitted case: FTS shall expose file contents/history only to users authorized and associated with the file, including Inbox/Outbox access; archived files remain readable to authorized users.
expected_result: Show/open only authorized associated files and retain authorized read access after archival.

purpose: Associated File Access Rule: verify prohibited outcome

purpose: Role-Based Access and Sensitive Action Rule: verify permitted outcome
preconditions: Actor, role context, file association, and lifecycle state meet rule conditions.
action_or_input: Exercise permitted case: FTS shall enforce RBAC, assigned-role restrictions, file association, and file-state authorization for FTS actions, including integrations.
expected_result: Permit only actions authorized by role/context/file association/file state; reject unauthorized sensitive actions.

purpose: Role-Based Access and Sensitive Action Rule: verify prohibited outcome

expected_result: Permit only actions authorized by role/context/file association/file state; reject unauthorized sensitive actions.

purpose: Audit Log and Chronological Versioning Rule: verify required outcome
preconditions: Actor, role context, file association, and lifecycle state meet rule conditions.
action_or_input: Exercise required case: FTS shall maintain audit records for creation, comments, attachments, forwarding, return, archival, and integration actions, and maintain chronological version history through recorded file updates.
expected_result: Append applicable audit/version record without rewriting prior chronological history.

purpose: Archival Rule: verify permitted outcome
preconditions: Actor, role context, file association, and lifecycle state meet rule conditions.
action_or_input: Exercise permitted case: Only the file owner may archive a completed circulated file; archived files remain permanently stored/readable to authorized users and are no longer modifiable or forwardable in collaborative processing.
expected_result: Allow archival only for the owner after collaborative completion; enforce archived read-only/no-forward state.

purpose: Archival Rule: verify prohibited outcome
preconditions: Actor, role context, file association, and lifecycle state meet rule conditions.
action_or_input: Exercise prohibited case: Only the file owner may archive a completed circulated file; archived files remain permanently stored/readable to authorized users and are no longer modifiable or forwardable in collaborative processing.
expected_result: Allow archival only for the owner after collaborative completion; enforce archived read-only/no-forward state.

purpose: Notification Trigger and Delivery Boundary Rule: verify required outcome
preconditions: Actor, role context, file association, and lifecycle state meet rule conditions.
action_or_input: Exercise required case: FTS shall trigger notifications for file received, file forwarded, file returned, file archived, and relevant role assignment/reassignment events; delivery uses Fusion integrated notification mechanisms.
expected_result: Create/trigger required notification event and hand it to the Fusion notification mechanism.

purpose: FTS Integration Boundary Rule: verify permitted outcome
preconditions: Actor, role context, file association, and lifecycle state meet rule conditions.
action_or_input: Exercise permitted case: FTS may provide file/workflow tracking APIs, approval-chain support, and file-based request tracking to other Fusion modules, while consuming modules retain ownership of their domain-specific actors, forms, policies, validations, and workflow semantics.
expected_result: Provide only authorized FTS capabilities under FTS RBAC/audit rules; do not assume ownership of consuming-module domain policy.
